about.description: Milkshake Momma was founded in 2019 in Crawford, Alabama as part of Southern Roots Country Store and Cafe. The business is known for Freak Shakes and Southern-style comfort foods. Founded by Sylvia Nolan, the concept has expanded to multiple locations including Columbus, GA and Orange Beach, AL. The company emphasizes community engagement, outstanding customer service, and a family-friendly atmosphere.
about.elevator_pitch: A Southern-style milkshake bar and restaurant concept serving indulgent Freak Shakes and authentic comfort food in a fun, family-friendly environment.
about.vibe: Fun, vibrant, community-focused, casual dining with a playful and larger-than-life atmosphere
about.insider_tip: The Freak Shakes created such a buzz that they became the signature item, with the founder Sylvia Nolan earning the nickname 'Milkshake Momma'
